scripts.build: npm run build -w @skillbridge/shared && npm run build -w @skillbridge/api && npm run build -w @skillbridge/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @skillbridge/shared && npm run build -w @skillbridge/web
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test: npm run test -w @skillbridge/shared && npm run test -w @skillbridge/api
scripts.db:screening-demo: npm run build -w @skillbridge/shared && cd apps/api && npx tsx prisma/screening-demo.ts
